scientific_limitations: The result classifies the poles of the phenomenological exponential-memory decoherence transfer function, not the BLP backflow phase diagram away from the third-order point.
The monotonicity statement applies to equatorial pure-qubit coherent ergotropy at the unique cusp and all real noise preparations of magnitude at most one.
No microscopic complete-positivity construction or independent scientific validation is established.
Earlier noise-model literature is fully credited; a closely related 2016 original was not available in full text, leaving a publication-priority risk.
title: Reentrant pole spectra and a monotone third-order cusp for coherent qubit work
